Write data to file(s) using NMwriteData

Source: R/datwrite.R
datwrite.Rd

This function writes data objects to files, with support for lists of data objects. It wraps NMwriteData and provides additional functionality for file path construction and metadata stamping.

Usage

datwrite(
  x,
  file,
  script,
  time,
  model,
  formats,
  path.format = NULL,
  subdir = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  fun.path = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A data frame or list of data frames to write

file

Character string specifying the output file name

script

Optional character string specifying the script name for stamping

time

Optional time stamp to include in output

model

Optional model object or path for organizing output files

formats

Character vector of output formats (passed to NMwriteData)

path.format

Character string or function defining the output path. Passed to pathFormat. Default (NULL) uses file as is.

subdir

Optional subdirectory for organizing output files

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppresses messages about ignored model/script arguments from path.format.

fun.path

Deprecated. Use path.format.

...

Additional arguments passed to NMwriteData

Value

A list of results from NMwriteData calls
